---
title: "Where City Documents Disagree"
---

*Last updated September 20, 2026.*

City, state and agency documents about these projects give different facts, dates or numbers for the same thing in a number of places. This page lists the main ones with both sources. A disagreement is not a finding of error. Many come from different dates, definitions or study areas. Where a difference is explained, the table says so. The full list (50 entries) is in the download at the bottom of the page.

## Homes, plans and rules

| Topic | One document says | Another says |
|---|---|---|
| Homes built | 464 homes and 65,000 sq ft on 7 sites, 2019–2025 (City Economic Development page) | About 400 since 2014 (Strategic Economics, July 7, 2026); its slide 11 sums to 321 completed plus 70 under construction |
| Homes entitled | 1,500 by 2018 (Implementation deck, slide 4) | "Over 1,500" as of 2022 (Specific Plan Chapter 1) |
| Inclusionary threshold | Rental buildings of 9 or more homes (City Specific Plan page) | 10 or more (Housing deck, slide 13) |
| Specific Plan goals | "Six goals," five listed (City page) | Four goals in the 2022 update; five (A–E) in 2014 (Chapter 1) |
| Priority Development Areas | "Three PDAs" (City page) | One PDA designated in 2007; Downtown, Midtown and Uptown are focus areas (Chapter 1) |
| Housing Element | Plan adopted "to advance" the 2023–2031 element (City page) | Earlier element was certified May 2015; 2023–2031 element adopted August 15, 2023 |
| Hana Gardens | 63 homes (Housing deck, slide 11) | 62 homes (fund report; May 6, 2025 agenda bill); finished 2018 (bill) or 2019 (fund report) |
| Elm Street project | 1715 Elm St, 16 homes, outside the Plan Area (Housing deck) | 1717 Elm St, 14 homes, inside the Plan Area (Implementation deck) |
| Second Plaza building address | 6617 Fairmount Avenue (May 6, 2025 agenda bill) | 6671 Fairmount Avenue (resolution and fund report) |
| Elora and Mayfair | "Mayfair Affordable," 69 homes by del Norte BART (May 6, 2025 bill) | "Elora," 69 homes by del Norte BART (March 17, 2026 bill; consultant decks) |
| Climate plan year | "2024 CAAP" (Richmond Street FAQ) | "2023 Climate Action and Adaptation Plan" (same site) |
| Specific Plan version | "Adopted 2022 version" (City page) | Redline; footers "August, 2014 - Corrected"; file named "September-2024" |

## Money

| Topic | One document says | Another says |
|---|---|---|
| Richmond Street total | $11,092,000 (City FAQ, printed September 20, 2026) | $12,798,340 plan; $12,878,610 with City administration (March 3, 2026). Explained: the FAQ shows the 2024–25 plan |
| Richmond Street "secured" | "$9 million" (July 15, 2025 slide 26) | $10,104,010 (2023 plan) and $11,092,010 (2024–25 plan) |
| Richmond Street on the CTC form | "Other sources" $10,836,000, implying $11,636,000 with the $800,000 | $12,798,340 (March 3, 2026 plan) |
| Richmond Street funding year | Funding "included as part of the Fiscal Year 2027-28 budget" (March 3, 2026 bill) | $4,345,330 shown in FY2027, the year beginning July 1, 2026 (proposed budget) |
| Cooperative agreement date | September 19, 2023 (resolution) | October 19, 2023 (Exhibit A) |
| del Norte cost | $12.7 million "secured" (July 15, 2025 slide) | $13.25 million (2021 estimate); $14.92 million (BART, 2023) |
| del Norte BART grant | $812,977 (BART memo, July 31, 2023) | $1.5 million (BART fact sheet, June 2025) |
| TOD grant totals | "$95 million" secured (May 6, 2025 bill) | "Over $60 million" for Elora and Plaza (consultant deck) |
| City housing fund | $95,000 remains (consultant deck) | $105,410 cash available at June 30, 2025 of $6,960,307 on paper (fund report) |
| Second Plaza application transportation amount | $2.9 million (May 6, 2025 bill) | $3.5 million (March 17, 2026 bill, describing the 2025 application; the budget puts $3.5 million in Round 10, where it is the Complete Streets part of a $40.2 million request) |

## AHSC grant documents

| Topic | One document says | Another says |
|---|---|---|
| Date of the first Plaza grant agreement | "On or about October 24, 2025" (Disbursement Agreement) | Signed October 31 and November 5, 2025 (Standard Agreement) |
| Guidelines cited | Guidelines dated October 31, 2019 (Disbursement Agreement) | Round 8 Guidelines dated December 14, 2023 (Standard Agreement); scoring table says "Round 7" |
| Approved date on exhibits | April 19, 2024 (Disbursement Agreement) | April 11, 2024 (Standard Agreement) |
| Construction timing | STI construction starts August 1, 2026 (Standard Agreement) | Bikeway payments August 2027 to April 2028 (Disbursement Agreement) |
| How a scope change is approved | Revision "shall require an amendment" (Standard Agreement) | "This email alone can serve as approval" (SGC email, May 20, 2026) |
| Bikeway miles | 2.22 miles verified (SGC email) | Current total 2.4 lane miles (City email) |
| Sidewalk location | "Oak Street sidewalks" (agreements, exhibits A-E.7 and B) | "Elm/Willow St Sidewalks" (Disbursement Agreement, Exhibit D heading) |
| BART railcars | "Two new BART railcars" (Round 9 narrative, first page) | "Three new BART railcars" (same narrative, later page) |

## Richmond Street design and process

| Topic | One document says | Another says |
|---|---|---|
| Bike lane type | Class IV protected bikeway (Round 9 application narrative) | Class II buffered lanes (state environmental notice, March 20, 2026; May 18, 2026 letter) |
| Traffic volume | 6,400 vehicles a day measured (City FAQ) | 8,400 modeled (City FAQ); 9,000 (SGC email) |
| Parking occupancy | About 46% (October 2024, Richmond Street) | About 33% (May 2025, wider area) |
| July 15, 2025 council action | "Approved" (a news report) | Study session; "No formal action" (agenda bill, slides, City FAQ) |
| Agenda item number | Item 6.D (March 17, 2026 bill) | "Item No. 6.C" (fund report footer) |
| Council minutes, March 3, 2026 | Consent item 6.G (a proclamation) is on the agenda | Item 6.G does not appear in the minutes |
| Consultant report timing | Housing analysis "on track" for spring 2026 (Housing Element progress report) | Reports dated July 7, 2026 |
